description: A small round zen garden tray filled with white sand sits on the table, with a tiny figurine and a small house inside it, and a yellow rake tool nearby. The right hand picks up the yellow rake and moves it over the sand, lowering it to touch down and dragging it across to smooth and form curved grooves, while the left hand stays close and then briefly reaches in to steady and guide the rake near the tray’s edge before pulling back.
